title: Azzurro Dream | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the home is a sanctuary of style and comfort, where natural light flows through open-concept living spaces accented by elegant finishes and coastal textures. The chef’s kitchen, outfitted with premium appliances, anchors the heart of the home and opens to a generous dining area and a cozy fireplace. Multiple balconies and patios invite moments of calm, while two serene primary suites offer private retreats with breathtaking Gulf views. Designed with families in mind, the home includes bunk rooms, media lounges, and accessible features such as an elevator and a handicap-friendly tub. Perfectly situated near celebrated dining, boutique shopping, and the scenic 30A bike trail, this estate is a serene and luxurious haven on Florida’s Emerald Coast. This exquisite Gulf-front estate captures the essence of refined coastal living along Seagrove Beach. With eight beautifully appointed bedrooms and eight-and-a-half bathrooms spread across four thoughtfully designed levels, it offers a perfect blend of sophistication and relaxed beach charm. A private boardwalk leads directly to the sugar-white sands, while expansive outdoor areas showcase a sparkling Gulf-facing pool, jetted spa, and a fully equipped grill station, ideal for sunset dinners beneath the open sky. With inviting extras like a golf cart, adult bikes, and beach chair setups, every detail is curated for effortless, luxurious days by the sea.
